body: Greg's reporting rule (2026-11-06 15:50Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #565), verbatim: „kodowanie to takze testy, koder powien przygotowac cala gotowa paczke. podzial powien byc kodowanie, integracja”. Report status in two phases only. KODOWANIE (coding) = the complete package of code AND tests, prepared and checked by the coder (focused checks green). INTEGRACJA (integration) = the review pair, required gates and landing. Never present code as done while its author is still preparing or checking tests. A RED focused run means the item is still in coding. This does not weaken any review or gate requirement. It applies to the EO and source-id unification reports and to every later report to Greg.
